Intro

Codriver brings AI code assistance directly to your cursor - no chat window, no context switching, no copy-pasting. It reads the RStudio editor context to determine the right action: generate new code from a comment, complete a line, continue from context, edit existing code, or suggest a comment.

Get started

Use codriver_configure() to connect an AI provider and set up the recommended keyboard shortcut. See Getting started for configuration guidance.

codriver_configure()
Configure codriver

Use codriver

Invoke codriver from the RStudio Addins menu or with its keyboard shortcut (Ctrl+/ by default). This function is not normally called directly. See Using codriver for an overview of modes and result presentation.

codriver()
Context-aware AI assistant for RStudio
